ByteDance is hiring a Software Engineer for the Seed Infrastructures SRE team, which supports compute infrastructure for AI foundation models. The role focuses on GPU cluster reliability, resource planning and efficiency, disaster recovery, deployment, lifecycle management, and production support.

Comp. & Benefits
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Maintain the stable operation of machine learning systems and support the stages of large-model development, training and deployment
Manage and plan the company's GPU resources, including cost and budget, across GPU / CPU machines, storage and related resources; provide resource data to support management decisions
Drive stability governance for clusters and production services; improve resource utilization and operational efficiency through platform-based, systematic approaches
Operate disaster recovery, service deployment and machine lifecycle management across multiple regions and data centers; provide a stable and efficient GPU operating environment
Provide operational support for systems and services; participate in troubleshooting of production and system issues

Required
1+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE or infrastructure engineering projects
Proficient in at least one or two of Go / Python / Shell in a Linux environment
Experience operating resource management and job scheduling systems for distributed systems; familiar with the Kubernetes ecosystem and architecture
Familiar with containerization technologies such as Docker / Kata
Strong sense of ownership and responsibility, with excellent learning agility, communication, self-motivation, and teamwork skills, as well as strong analytical and logical thinking abilities to effectively abstract and break down complex business logic
Preferred
Hands-on experience operating GPU clusters or ML training / inference platforms
Familiarity with observability tooling (metrics, logging, alerting) and on-call practices
Contributions to automation or platform tooling that measurably improved resource utilization or operational efficiency

A 401(k) savings plan with company match.
